description: The write_file happy path: creating a new text file stages first (never auto-executes), executing lands the file at the intended path, and undo removes it (recycled to the Trash). Self-cleans via teardown.

turns.prompt: Create a file called notes.txt in {{scratch}} containing the line 'hello world'.

description: The append_to_file happy path: appending to an existing file stages first, executing succeeds, and undo restores the prior contents (the file itself remains). State can assert presence only, so byte-exactness of the restore is owned by the unit round-trip test.

turns.prompt: Add the line 'sync complete' to the end of {{scratch}}/log.txt.

description: Overwrite safety: asking to create a file where one already exists must not clobber it — write_file is create-only and staging refuses an occupied path. Nothing may execute, and the reply should surface that the file already exists.

turns.prompt: Create a new file at {{scratch}}/have.txt with the content 'replacement'.
